biocontainers.name: bioconductor-rnamodr.ml
biocontainers.summary: Detecting patterns of post-transcriptional modifications using machine learning

biotools.summary: RNAmodR.ML extend the functionality of the RNAmodR package and classical detection strategies towards detection through machine learning models. RNAmodR.ML provides classes, functions and an example workflow to establish a detection stratedy, which can be packaged.
